title: Salem Wasn’t the Worst
sentences: Salem was colonial America’s deadliest witch hunt, but it wasn’t even close to Europe’s worst.
Twenty people were executed in Salem.
In Scotland, historians estimate about 2,500 people were executed for witchcraft.
In the German territory of Bamberg, about 900 were put to death between 1626 and 1632.
Across Europe, estimates run from 40,000 to 60,000 executions.
Salem is simply the one Americans remember best.
caption:
Salem was colonial America's deadliest witch hunt. By Europe's standards, it was small.
